question: Should ClawHub staff hide/quarantine, rename, or decline action on @kingaiwork/shieldcortex after verifying the public impersonation evidence?
rationale: The source tree already supports the relevant claim and moderation paths, but only staff can adjudicate real-world ownership and take production moderation action.

options.title: Hide or Quarantine Pending Resolution
options.body: Temporarily remove the disputed listing from public install/discovery while staff verifies ownership and contacts the publisher if needed.

options.title: Rename the Disputed Listing
options.body: Allow the content to remain only if it stops using the ShieldCortex namespace and misleading upgrade branding.

options.title: Decline or Ask for More Proof
options.body: Leave the listing active only if staff determines the public evidence is insufficient or unrelated after review.

recommendation.title: Hide or Quarantine Pending Resolution
recommendation.body: Temporarily remove the disputed listing from public install/discovery while staff verifies ownership and contacts the publisher if needed.
